name: クロマニョン人 女性
notes: Adult female with a feminine face and body; primitive hide/fur wraps, rawhide ties and footwear.
Original TRELLIS geometry retained through measured reduction. Existing source UV atlas preserved; selected reference projected onto facial colour only.
22 bones, normalized maximum-four skin weights and eight in-place clips. Walk/run playback scales to server movement speed.
Static front, sides, rear, top and bottom and sampled animation poses reviewed. Complete limbs and covered garment; no gross disjoint skin ribbons.
Prototype limits: hair and fur remain solid reconstructed clusters; facial side detail is simplified, and the fur waist wrap stretches slightly in large strides.
Gender changes appearance only. Missing gender starts female; male models remain available.
Small dark rear-waist albedo artifact replaced with colour sampled from neighbouring source texels; no geometry substitution.
Hunting revision 03 adds Attack; original mesh, rig, textures and earlier clips retained byte-for-byte. Previous delivery archived.
